err.cannotShare: Only someone who may let people into this base's area can open it to a class — or the base must be public. Ask whoever manages the base.
err.noStudents: This class has no students role.
err.noBase: This class has no knowledge base.
err.failed: That did not work. Try again in a moment.

page.noClass: This address leads to no class
page.scanAgain: Scan the QR code your teacher shows once more.
page.youLead: You lead this class. Here you show its QR code and see how your students are doing.
page.noCode: To join, scan the QR code your teacher shows.
page.codeDead: This code no longer works. Ask your teacher for a new one.
page.haveAccount: Already in this class with an account? Sign in.
page.noBase: The knowledge base of this class cannot be opened. Ask your teacher.
page.noMap: This base has no map yet.
page.more: More about learning in this class

join.title: Join {name}
join.lede: Your teacher invites you to learn together. Choose how you want to join:
join.newSays: A login and a password — your progress on every device.
join.inSays: Sign in and join the class.
join.guestSays: Just your name. You get a personal link — keep it safe.
join.loginHint: At least 3 characters, e.g. anna.k — you sign in with it.
join.passwordHint: At least 8 characters. Write it down somewhere safe.
join.consent: I want to learn in the class „{name}”, and I agree that the teacher sees my name, my answers and my progress.
join.needConsent: Tick that you agree — without it you cannot join.
join.busyAccount: Creating your account — this can take up to half a minute…
join.guestNote: Without an account your progress is tied to a personal link. Lose the link and the progress is gone.
join.noPerson: This account has no person to join with. Sign in again.
join.failed: Joining did not work. Try again in a moment.
join.noController: You cannot join this class yet: nobody is responsible for personal data here (data controller). The teacher has to set one first — then the same code will work.

keep.title: This is your personal link
keep.lede: It is your key to this class. Keep it — with it you continue on any device. Without it your progress is lost.
keep.how: Tip: copy it into a note on your phone, or send it to yourself in a message.

tab.lede: A class learns this base together. Show the students the QR code — they join with an account or without one, and you see their progress here.
tab.cannot: You cannot open this base to a class: only someone who may let people into its area can (or the base must be public).
tab.empty: No class yet. Give it a name and create it — then show the QR code.
tab.name: New class

stage.role: Creating the students' key — this takes a few seconds…

card.renewSays: The old code stops working. Everyone who has joined stays in the class.
card.closeSays: Nobody new can join with the code. Everyone who has joined stays. You can make a new code later.
card.notYours: This code was made by someone else — only they can show it. A new code works for you too.
card.lessonHint: A lesson: plan it here („Plan a lesson": start, target, parts) or start it on the map — switch to “I'm leading” and choose “Lead here” on a tower.

qr.label: QR code of the class {name}
qr.scan: Scan the code with your phone's camera to join.

home.title: Your learning
home.none: You are not in a class yet. When your teacher shows a QR code, scan it with your phone's camera.
home.another: Another class? Scan its QR code — it is added here.

console.joinOpen: Joining is open. In the class: {count}.
console.joinClosed: Joining is closed — nobody new can join. You can open it again with a new code.
console.noLessons: This class has no lessons or assignments yet.
console.noController: Nobody is responsible for the data of this class (data controller) — so nobody can join it. Set one in the settings of the class area, or once in the knowledge base’s area (classes inherit it).
console.noControllerMove: This class lies outside the knowledge base’s area, so it does not inherit its data controller — that is why nobody can join. Move it into the base’s area (one click) or set a controller in the class itself.
console.moveUnder: Move the class into the base’s area

roster.lede: Everyone in the class. Someone without an account comes in with their own link — if they lose it, show it to them again or give them a new one.
roster.none: Nobody has joined yet. Show the QR code under „Joining”.
roster.showSays: The link of {name}. Let them scan the code or open the link on their device — they come back to their progress.
roster.freshSays: The new link of {name}. The old one no longer works; the progress stays. Let them scan the code or open the link.
roster.relinkSays: The old link stops working (on every device). Their progress stays — the new link leads to it.
roster.removeSays: Their link stops working. Their answers so far stay in the class progress.
roster.accountSays: Has an account — comes in by signing in. No link needed.
roster.noKey: I cannot open this person’s key (this device holds no key of the class area).
roster.noOldLink: This link can no longer be read — give a new link.
